findings.sessionStorage: Neon PostgreSQL sessions table (Token-based hash lookup)
findings.inMemorySseLimitation: SSE client connections are held in Node.js process memory (Map<string, Response>). Across multiple independent instances without a Redis Pub/Sub backplane, SSE events emitted on Instance A will not reach clients connected to Instance B.
findings.multiInstanceSupportVerdict: Single Instance Fully Supported. Multi-instance horizontal scaling requires Redis/Postgres LISTEN-NOTIFY pub/sub backplane for SSE broadcasting.
